speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: I hope we will give the Committee some time to deliberate on this and we will share more information when the deliberations are completed.

speaker: Ms Jessica Tan Soon Neo (East Coast)
text: I understand that there is deliberation in terms of improving the whistle-blowing protection.

speaker: Ms Jessica Tan Soon Neo (East Coast)
text: But, currently, what can be done if employers do not provide that safe environment for employees to speak up?

speaker: Ms Jessica Tan Soon Neo (East Coast)
text: What actions can be taken against employers who victimised employees and not just for dismissal but, usually, different treatment.

speaker: Ms Jessica Tan Soon Neo (East Coast)
text: The second one is, what recourse do employees have, if they do face retaliation for reporting discrimination?

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: To reassure the Member as well, TAFEP, in their experience in dealing with such cases, these incidences are actually very rare and far in between.

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: But having said that, anyone who feels that they have been targeted because of whistle-blowing, please let MOM and TAFEP know.

speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan
text: One supplementary question for the Senior Minister of State.

speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan
text: On this point on retaliation which the Member brought up, I think it also borders on the issue of workplace harassment.

speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan
text: Currently, we have an advisory on managing workplace harassment.

speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan
text: I hope the Senior Minister of State, as part of the whole review team, will also look at this topic of workplace harassment to revise and of course update this advisory in light of what is happening in the various workplaces and given the uncertain and uneven outlook.

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: Hopefully, with legislation, they will protect the employees better.
